results.title: Shirley Temple (short film)
results.overview: A silly interaction between a server and a restaurant guest turns into a beautiful moment of connection over sobriety.

results.title: It's Pronounced Dave
results.overview: A far-right South Asian MP candidate questions his campaign when he begins thinking in his native language.

results.title: Volta
results.overview: A group of young activists orchestrate an unlikely and high-risk operation to force the CEO of a major bank to question his convictions.

results.title: Laiba's Home
results.overview: Laiba ka Ghar explores resistance, love, and hope. Jasmin, a young mother in her twenties, valued education but married at 16, had her first child before 18, and moved to Bengaluru with her husband after being ostracised by her family.

results.title: All of Us
results.overview: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.

results.title: OLATS
results.overview: A recently unemployed man, looking for a distraction between job applications, becomes addicted to an online gambling app until it begins taking more than just his money.

results.title: Mallika Vilasam
results.overview: A protective man becomes suspicious when a young writer grows close to the mother he considers his own, only to discover that the stranger he feared letting into their home may become family.

results.title: Somethin' Stupid
results.overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

results.title: Another Sea Behind Another Wall
results.overview: A lifeguard in his late 60s from the Palestinian National Rescue Team-North District, who seems to be highly dedicated to his job, watches over the beaches of the sea.

results.title: Stream of Terror
results.overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

results.title: Reform Zara
results.overview: John Galliano’s process of reworking garments for Zara unfolds alongside theatrical tableaux suspended between past and future. Intimate conversations and observations of dressmaking reveal how a pocket alters posture, an opening changes movement, and clothing becomes character. Moving between documentary and fiction, the film explores imagination, memory and authorship through the transformation of familiar forms.

results.title: 12.08/F0F1
results.overview: A group of people experience peculiar symptoms after a solar eclipse.

results.title: Heart of the Lion
results.overview: Moving between life in London and Hong Kong, this film follows Kelvin Chan, a British-born Chinese lion dancer, as he explores how the routines and rituals of a creative, spiritual practice may provide their own sense of belonging.

results.title: Samhain: The Birth of Halloween
results.overview: Michael Londra, host of the popular travel series Ireland with Michael, takes a spine-tingling journey through Ireland to uncover Samhain, the ancient Celtic festival that gave rise to Halloween. Blending rich history, haunting folklore, and modern traditions, the film reveals the origins of a holiday now celebrated in many parts of the world.

results.title: Stagehand
results.overview: A newly hired stagehand struggles with his first day on the job

results.title: A Festa da Desordem de uma Umbra Eterna
results.original_title: A Festa da Desordem de uma Umbra Eterna

results.title: Bathin
results.overview: Bathin is a horror short film that shows how a man surrenders his body to a malevolent god who watches him and manifests as the sun. With a gaze that unsettles and exhausts, Bathin seeks terror under the all-seeing light of the sun.

results.title: Cars: Spooky Halloween Adventure
results.overview: It's Halloween night in Radiator Springs, and Lightning and his best friend Mater are enjoying the festivities at the annual spooky block party. But when Lightning gets bored of the flavored gasoline, roasted lug nuts, and jack-cone-lanterns, he convinces Mater to check out the old haunted garage on the edge of town. Will the two friends be brave enough to make it through the night without getting spooked?
